messages.subject: For Masood M. Sharif Mahmood | Digital infrastructure, government relations and regional strategy
messages.body:
Dear e& Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Masood M. Sharif Mahmood, Group Chief Executive Officer.

As e& continues its evolution into a global technology group, growth increasingly depends on strong alignment across governments, regulators, infrastructure partners and operating companies. That interface closely matches the work I lead today in a complex emerging-market environment.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regional stakeholder strategy and regulated-market execution might support e&'s international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to e&.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
